hybrid_bridge_pool.translated_query: भौतिक संपत्ति स्थायी सुख क्यों नहीं देती?

answer.answer: Material wealth does not provide lasting happiness because the happiness experienced upon acquiring material objects is always temporary and followed by sorrow or new desires. When a desire is fulfilled, it is immediately replaced by another stronger desire, making the pursuit of material possessions endless and futile. Moreover, the happiness derived from material objects is subjective and varies from person to person, indicating that the objects themselves do not contain true happiness. True happiness is not found in material things, as even the pleasures of higher realms like the abode of Brahmā do not bring perfect happiness, and desires remain unfulfilled despite acquiring wealth or possessions. Therefore, material wealth cannot fulfill the goal of Supreme Bliss, and the intellect must realize this to end inner desires and attain lasting peace [1][2][4][5][6][7][8].

hybrid_bridge_pool.translated_query: Why does permanent happiness not come from paisa (money) and dhan (wealth)?

answer.answer: Paisa aur dhan se permanent sukh isliye nahi milta kyunki jab hum kisi vastu ko prapt karte hain, to shuru mein sukh hota hai, lekin wo sukh turant dukh mein badal jata hai. Har iccha poori hone ke baad nai iccha utpann hoti hai, jisse lalach badhta hai aur sukh sthayi nahi rehta. Jaise ek vyakti jo crore pati ban jata hai, wo arabpati banne ki chah karta hai. Is tarah, dhan se milne wala sukh sirf pal bhar ka hota hai aur uske baad chinta, dar aur dukh aata hai. Isliye dhan se kabhi bhi asli aur sthayi sukh nahi milta[1][2][4][5][6].

answer.answer: Devotion should begin in childhood because it is easier to develop attachment to God at a young age without the distractions and attachments that come with adult life. As indicated in the passages, children can engage in devotion while still performing their worldly duties without becoming attached to those duties, as exemplified by Prahlad's advice to "engage in devotion to God at a young age and do other work without attachment" [1]. This early start helps cultivate a sincere and desireless devotion, which is essential for attaining God's grace and divine love [4][5]. Starting devotion early allows the mind to focus on God rather than worldly desires, which is crucial since the mind cannot hold both simultaneously [5].

भक्ति बचपन से इसलिए शुरू करनी चाहिए क्योंकि छोटी आयु में भगवान में लग जाना चाहिए और बाकी काम भी करते रहना चाहिए, लेकिन काम में मन का अटैचमेंट नहीं होना चाहिए। जैसे प्रहलाद ने कहा, "कौमार आचरे प्राज्यो धर्म भागवताम," अर्थात् बचपन से ही धर्म और भगवान की भक्ति में लग जाना चाहिए, जिससे मन स्थिर रहे और भक्ति की नींव मजबूत हो जाए। इससे जीवन के अन्य कार्यों में भी मन का अटैचमेंट नहीं होगा और भक्ति की प्रगति होगी[1][2]। 

इसके अतिरिक्त, प्रारंभिक अवस्था में संसार से संपर्क कम करना चाहिए और मन को किसी भी सांसारिक वस्तु से न जोड़ना चाहिए, तभी भक्ति पूर्ण होती है। जैसे मक्खन दूध से अलग होता है, वैसे ही जब हम संसार से अलग होकर केवल भगवान में लीन हो जाते हैं, तभी परम प्रेम की प्राप्ति होती है[4]।
